quizName:
Sign Test
									  					
									  														  					Check how well you know road signs.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that people may be crossing the road. Watch for people in the crosswalk. Slow down and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Fines double in a work zone.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They warn you about road conditions ahead. This sign tells you that bicycles may cross the road ahead.

questions.question: If you see this sign, what should you do?

options.text: Keep your speed the same until you see the new speed limit sign.
Start slowing down your vehicle now.
Do not slow down because traffic will back up.
You may slow down if you want to.

questions.correctAnswerText: Start slowing down your vehicle now.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you to begin slowing down now. The new speed limit will start at the next speed limit sign.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The road curves left, then right.
The road curves right, then left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road curves right, then left.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you the road ahead will curve to the right and then to the left. Slow down so you can safely drive through these curves.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign tells you that traffic may be coming toward you from the opposite direction.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign tells you to stay in the right lane. It warns you about a hazard ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign tells you that the road will soon become a divided highway.

questions.question: If you see this sign above your lane, what must you do?

options.text: You can continue straight or exit the freeway from this lane.
You can stay in your lane and go straight through.
You must exit the freeway if you stay in this lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must exit the freeway if you stay in this lane.
questions.explanation: When you see an "Exit only" sign above your lane, that lane does not continue through the interchange. It becomes an exit ramp. You must either change lanes to go straight or stay in the lane and exit.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a four-way intersection is coming ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead curves only to the right.
The road ahead turns sharply to the right.
The road ahead curves to the right and then to the left.
The road ahead curves to the left and then to the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead curves to the right and then to the left.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings and warn about road hazards ahead. This sign tells you the road will curve right first, then curve left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This warning sign tells you that bicycles may be on the road ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This warning sign is yellow with black markings. It warns you that a traffic signal is ahead. Be ready to stop for a red light or yield to cross traffic.

questions.question: What do these signs mean?
questions.explanation: These are object markers. They are yellow with black markings and warn you about objects or areas that are dangerous. Avoid them.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot make a U-turn at this location.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You must turn either right or left.
A road joins from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must turn either right or left.
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a Y intersection ahead. You must choose to go right or left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This is a regulation sign that tells drivers which direction to drive on a one-way street.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This is a yellow warning sign with black markings. It tells you to watch for buggies on the road ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This is a yellow warning sign with black markings. It tells you that a playground is near. Watch for children on or near the road.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You are about to enter a one-way street from the wrong direction.
You may proceed if the way is clear.
Come to a complete stop before proceeding.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are about to enter a one-way street from the wrong direction.
questions.explanation: If you see this sign, you are going the wrong way on a one-way street. You risk a head-on crash. Turn around carefully.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The left lane is for vehicles with a certain number of people.
Certain turning movements are allowed from certain lanes.
Drivers in both lanes must merge smoothly.

questions.correctAnswerText: The left lane is for vehicles with a certain number of people.
questions.explanation: This sign marks a high occupancy vehicle (HOV) lane. Only buses and vehicles with a driver plus one or more passengers can use this lane.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The road turns sharply right, then left.
The road turns sharply left, then right.
The road curves to the left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road turns sharply right, then left.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road ahead will turn sharply to the right and then to the left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs with black markings prepare drivers for upcoming road hazards. This sign alerts you that the shoulder is lower than the paved road ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot make a U-turn where it is posted.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The right lane will end soon.
A highway entrance ramp is ahead.
The left lane will end soon.

questions.correctAnswerText: The right lane will end soon.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the right lane ends ahead.

questions.question: What does this black and yellow sign mean?

options.text: The road to the right is one-way only.
There is a detour to the right because of roadwork ahead.
Slow down because the road changes direction sharply ahead.
There is a crossroad to your right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down because the road changes direction sharply ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road ahead turns at a sharp angle (in this case, to the right). You should slow down as much as you would when turning at an intersection.

questions.question: What should you worry about most when you see this sign?

options.text: Your headlights may not align if one side of your car is higher than the other.
You may damage a tire if you drift onto the shoulder.
You may hydroplane if the shoulder has water on it.
You may lose control of your vehicle if you drift onto the shoulder.

questions.correctAnswerText: You may lose control of your vehicle if you drift onto the shoulder.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the shoulder is lower than the road. If one wheel drops onto the low shoulder, do not slam on the brakes or steer sharply. This can cause you to lose control of your vehicle.

questions.question: What does this green arrow on a lane control signal mean?

options.text: No traffic is allowed in this lane.
You must merge into this lane.

questions.explanation: A steady green arrow pointing down over a traffic lane means you can use that lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Orange construction signs warn drivers about construction zones. This sign tells you that a flagger is ahead. Follow the flagger's directions.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs with black markings prepare drivers for road hazards. This sign warns that traffic is merging from the right. Be ready to let them merge safely.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road ahead has a series of curves and turns.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that two-way traffic is coming.

questions.question: What should you do if you see this sign?

options.text: You may pass a slow vehicle if you do it quickly.
You may pass if you know the road ahead.
You may pass only at night.

questions.explanation: This is a regulation sign. It is white and rectangular with black markings. You must follow the rules on all regulation signs. Where this sign is posted, you cannot pass other vehicles.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must stop if other cars stop.

questions.explanation: This is a warning sign. Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. They warn you about hazards ahead. This sign tells you a stop sign is coming, so be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This is a construction sign. It is orange and warns you about work zones. Slow down and drive carefully when you see this sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This is a warning sign. Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. They prepare you for upcoming road hazards. This sign alerts you to a curve in the road ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Construction zones are dangerous for drivers and workers. Orange signs warn you about construction ahead. Be careful and slow down when you see this sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This is a regulation sign. Regulation signs control traffic and tell drivers what they must do. Large trucks are not allowed where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Stop only if other cars are coming.

questions.explanation: This sign shows where bicycles cross or ride. The arrow points to the crossing area. Drive carefully in this area because cyclists regularly cross or travel near traffic.

questions.question: This is a ____ sign.
questions.explanation: This is a triangular "Yield" sign. When you see it, slow down and check for traffic. Let pedestrians and other vehicles go first. Only stop if you need to.

questions.question: This sign shows one type of:
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a road crossing ahead is coming.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Keep driving at your current speed.

questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a traffic signal is coming up ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is a sharp turn ahead. Slow down.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a sharp turn ahead. Slow down.
questions.explanation: This yellow sign with black markings warns drivers about upcoming road hazards. It tells you to reduce your speed because there is a sharp turn ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Be ready for a sharp left turn ahead.
Follow the detour to avoid the work zone.

questions.correctAnswerText: Follow the detour to avoid the work zone.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that the road ahead has changed due to construction. Follow the marked detour route.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn right at this intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Orange construction signs warn drivers about construction zones. This sign tells you that the right lane ahead is closed due to work.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign means you cannot park your vehicle in this area at any time of day or night.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Fines are doubled in work zones.

questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells you to watch for people crossing the road ahead.

questions.question: When you see this sign, what does it mean?

options.text: There is an object on the road.
Traffic is coming from the right.
The road curves sharply to the left.
There is a merge point ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road curves sharply to the left.
questions.explanation: Chevron signs show you which direction the road curves. The arrow points left, so the road curves sharply to the left. You may see several of these signs through the curve.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a school crossing is coming up ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells you that a yield sign is coming up. Be ready to stop and let other drivers and pedestrians go first.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you a divided highway is ahead. The road splits into two separate one-way roads. Stay in the right lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert drivers to hazards. This sign warns you that wet roads ahead may be slippery. Drive carefully.

questions.question: What does this sign tell you?

options.text: No turns are allowed on this road.
There are a series of curves ahead.
The road may be slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: There are a series of curves ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you of a winding road with three or more curves ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign warn drivers about?

options.text: An upcoming curve in the road.

questions.correctAnswerText: An upcoming curve in the road.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you the road ahead curves to the right.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Traffic flows only in the direction of the arrow.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic flows only in the direction of the arrow.
questions.explanation: This one-way sign tells you traffic only moves in the direction shown by the arrow.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down if an emergency vehicle is approaching.
Look both ways as you cross the intersection.
Always come to a full stop at the intersection.
Slow down and be prepared to stop if necessary.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and be prepared to stop if necessary.
questions.explanation: Slow down as you approach this intersection. Be ready to stop and let other vehicles and pedestrians go first. You must stop if traffic requires it.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Don't drink if you are going to drive.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road becomes slippery when wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is a 35 mph speed zone after the curve ahead.
Drive no less than 35 mph around the curve ahead.
Curve ahead, speeds of 35 mph or slower are recommended.
Stay in the right-hand lane if not driving over 35 mph.

questions.correctAnswerText: Curve ahead, speeds of 35 mph or slower are recommended.
questions.explanation: This sign shows a curve ahead in the direction of the arrow. The recommended safe speed is 35 mph or slower.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign alerts you that farm machinery may be in the area.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: All traffic must go straight ahead.
A road joins from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: A road joins from the right.
questions.explanation: This sign shows a T-intersection ahead. Another road joins from the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They tell drivers about upcoming road conditions and hazards. This sign warns you that the road ahead has curves. Slow down.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that the road ahead is divided by a median or divider. Stay to the right of the divider.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Drive with caution and be ready to slow down.
Do not drive in this lane.
You must come to a complete stop and yield the right-of-way.
Slow down, be prepared to stop, and yield the right-of-way if needed.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down, be prepared to stop, and yield the right-of-way if needed.
questions.explanation: This triangle sign means yield. Slow down as you approach the intersection. Be ready to stop. Let other vehicles, bicyclists, and pedestrians pass safely before you continue.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign indicates a low ground railroad crossing. Railroad tracks cross the road at a steep slope. Low vehicles may drag or get stuck on the tracks.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They tell drivers about upcoming road conditions and hazards. This sign warns you that cattle may cross the road ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulation signs tell drivers what they must do. This sign is in parking lots and marks reserved spaces for vehicles with a handicap sticker, tag, or license plate.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulation signs tell drivers what they must do. This sign shows the direction you must drive when turning onto a one-way street.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road curves right. Slow to the safe speed shown.
Divided highway begins. Slow to the safe speed shown.
Merge. Slow to the safe speed shown.
Winding road ahead. Slow to the safe speed shown.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road curves right. Slow to the safe speed shown.
questions.explanation: This sign shows that the road curves to the right. Slow down to the safe speed indicated (35 mph in this case).

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a flagger is ahead controlling traffic in a construction area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that you cannot turn right at this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Yield when turning left on green.

questions.correctAnswerText: Yield when turning left on green.
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers turning left at a green light to let oncoming traffic pass first. You can turn left only when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Five-sided signs warn that a school is nearby. Watch for children and pedestrians on the road. Follow any instructions from a crossing guard.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down when the road is wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down when the road is wet.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road is slippery when wet. Reduce your speed, avoid sudden braking or turns, and keep more distance between your car and the one ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign warn drivers about?

options.text: The right lane ends. Merge left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The right lane ends. Merge left.
questions.explanation: This sign shows that the right lane will end. Traffic must move to the left lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you to wait for the left turn signal before turning left. Turn only when the signal shows it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn right at this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a steep hill is coming.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Five-sided signs warn that a school is nearby. Watch for children and pedestrians. This sign can mean either a school crossing or school zone.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign shows the slowest legal speed. Do not drive slower than the speed shown.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a steep downhill section ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers that left turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What is the correct order of traffic lights from top to bottom?
questions.explanation: Traffic lights always have red on top and green on the bottom when arranged vertically. When arranged horizontally, red is on the left and green is on the right.

questions.question: What type of sign is this?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped and yellow with black lettering or symbols. They warn drivers about hazards or special situations ahead.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You must come to a complete stop.
Drive with caution and be ready to stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must come to a complete stop.
questions.explanation: An eight-sided sign always means stop. You must come to a complete stop and wait for vehicles and pedestrians to clear before going.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. They prepare drivers for upcoming road conditions. This sign warns you that an intersection is coming.

questions.question: What should you do when you see this sign?

options.text: Follow a detour to the right.
Get ready to enter a one-way street.
Stay on the main highway if you can.
Follow a detour to the right, but only if it's convenient.

questions.correctAnswerText: Follow a detour to the right.
questions.explanation: Work area signs are orange with black lettering or symbols. Detour signs direct drivers to take an alternate route around a blocked road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A community service group is picking up trash along the highway ahead.
Workers are on or very close to the road in the work zone ahead.
There is a pedestrian crosswalk ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Workers are on or very close to the road in the work zone ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that workers may be on or near the road ahead. Drive carefully through the work zone.

questions.question: What must you do when you see this sign?

options.text: Stop completely and check for pedestrians and cross traffic.
Slow down without coming to a complete stop.
Stop completely and wait for a green light.
Slow down and check for traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop completely and check for pedestrians and cross traffic.
questions.explanation: Any eight-sided sign is a stop sign. You must come to a complete stop and check for pedestrians and traffic before proceeding.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Fines double in a work zone.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. This sign warns you that the area ahead has low clearance.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Trucks are permitted on an upcoming narrow bridge.
The bridge ahead is open to one-way traffic only.
The bridge ahead is wide enough for only one car at a time.
The bridge ahead may be too narrow to meet or pass a truck.

questions.correctAnswerText: The bridge ahead may be too narrow to meet or pass a truck.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. This sign warns you that an upcoming bridge may be too narrow to pass a truck. Drive carefully.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that U-turns are not allowed at this location.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You must travel at the speed indicated.
The maximum legal speed on this road is 55 mph.
You must travel through the intersection at the posted speed.

questions.correctAnswerText: The maximum legal speed on this road is 55 mph.
questions.explanation: This is a speed limit sign. It shows the fastest speed you can legally drive on this road. In bad weather like rain, snow, or ice, you should drive slower than the posted limit.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They prepare you for road hazards ahead. This sign warns you that a T intersection is coming. Be ready to turn left or right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Pedestrians walking along the road ahead.
Be alert for construction workers on the road.

questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a pedestrian crossing is coming. Drive carefully where people may be crossing the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Merging traffic is approaching from the left.
Right lane ends ahead, merge left.

questions.correctAnswerText: Right lane ends ahead, merge left.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that the right lane will end soon. You must move your vehicle to the left lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Highway changes ahead and to the right.
Hiking trails ahead and to the right.
Hotel ahead and to the right.
Hospital ahead and to the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Hospital ahead and to the right.
questions.explanation: This sign shows that a hospital with emergency services is located to the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped and yellow with black markings. They alert you to road hazards. This sign warns you that a steep hill is coming. Adjust your speed to drive safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign alerts you to a nearby fire station. Be aware that emergency vehicles may be on the roadway.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A series of curves is ahead.
The road will be slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road will be slippery when wet.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road becomes very slippery when it is wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot drive on this road or driveway from your current direction. It is not safe. If you see this sign, turn around and find another way.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The highway ahead is under construction.
Loose gravel covers the highway ahead.
The highway ahead has been sanded for icy conditions.

questions.correctAnswerText: Loose gravel covers the highway ahead.
questions.explanation: Warning signs alert drivers to hazards ahead. They are yellow with black markings. This sign warns that loose gravel is on the road. Drive with extra care because your tires will have less grip on gravel.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs alert drivers to upcoming road conditions and hazards. They are yellow with black markings. This sign warns of a steep hill ahead. Slow down to avoid brake damage or a crash.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The overpass ahead has low clearance.
Two lanes of traffic moving in opposite directions are merging.

questions.correctAnswerText: The overpass ahead has low clearance.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the overpass ahead has low clearance. Do not pass under it if your vehicle is taller than the height shown on the sign (13 feet 6 inches in this case).

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Construction zones can be dangerous for drivers and workers. Orange construction signs warn drivers to be careful in these areas. This sign tells you that a flagger is ahead. Follow their directions.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the overpass ahead has low clearance. Do not pass under it if your vehicle is taller than the height shown on the sign (13 feet 6 inches in this case).

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Construction zones can be dangerous for drivers and workers. Orange construction signs warn drivers to be careful in these areas. This sign tells you to take a different route because the regular road is blocked.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Construction zones can be dangerous for drivers and workers. Orange construction signs warn drivers to be careful in these areas. This sign tells you that workers may be on or near the road. Drive with extra caution.

questions.question: You see a merging traffic sign on the freeway. What should you do?

options.text: Speed up to avoid slowing traffic.
Move to another lane, if safe, to let traffic enter.

questions.correctAnswerText: Move to another lane, if safe, to let traffic enter.
questions.explanation: On roads with two or more lanes, make room for vehicles entering. If the lane next to you is empty, move over to let traffic in.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulation signs tell drivers what they must do. This sign tells you that from this lane, you can turn left or go straight ahead at the intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulation signs tell drivers what they must do. This sign means U-turns are not allowed wherever it is posted.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that deer cross the road in this area. Slow down, stay alert, and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers that there are multiple left turn lanes available. Drivers in the far left lane must turn left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells drivers to watch for traffic entering from an upcoming side road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means the center lane is shared. Both directions can use it only to turn left. Do not use the center lane for regular driving.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A red circle with a red slash means the action is not allowed. You cannot turn right where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that traffic is merging into the road from the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells drivers that lanes are shifting. Follow the new lane direction.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you to stay to the right of the divider ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells you to watch for hazards ahead and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign alerts you that deer may cross the road in this area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This is a regulation sign. It tells drivers what they must and must not do. This sign means you cannot park here.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This is a regulation sign. It is posted at the end of one-way streets. It warns you not to go down that road. If you see this sign, stop and turn around.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Drive with the flow of traffic.
Slow down for the next 50 miles.
Police enforce speed limits for the next 50 miles.
The speed limit is 50 miles per hour.

questions.correctAnswerText: The speed limit is 50 miles per hour.
questions.explanation: A speed limit sign shows the fastest speed you are allowed to drive.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The fastest safe speed for a residential area.
The fastest safe speed for a highway exit.
The fastest safe speed for a highway entrance.
The fastest safe speed for a work zone.

questions.correctAnswerText: The fastest safe speed for a highway exit.
questions.explanation: This sign shows the fastest safe speed for leaving a highway. In this example, the safe speed is 30 mph.

questions.question: What should you do when you see this sign?

options.text: Look for a train station ahead.
Slow down and let trains pass.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and let trains pass.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that railroad tracks are ahead. Always slow down when you see this sign. Trains cannot stop for you, so you must let them cross before you go.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This is a regulation sign. It tells you that from this lane, you can either turn right or drive straight at the intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a roundabout is coming. Drive slowly when entering a roundabout and let other cars go first.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. They alert you to road conditions ahead. This sign warns you that a new lane is being added to the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on a yellow background. This sign warns you that the road gets slippery when wet. Be extra careful because your car may be harder to control.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Orange signs warn you about construction zones. These areas are dangerous for both drivers and workers. This sign tells you that penalties for bad driving are doubled in work zones.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on a yellow background. They alert drivers to upcoming hazards. This sign warns that a divided highway is coming.

questions.question: This sign warns you of what ahead?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a railroad crossing is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulation signs tell drivers what they must do. This sign means you can park for a maximum of two hours during the posted times.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They prepare drivers for upcoming road conditions and hazards. This sign tells drivers that a detour is 1,000 feet ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow and black. They prepare drivers for upcoming road conditions and hazards. This sign tells you a lane is ending. Be ready for traffic to merge.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The traffic signal ahead is showing red.
The traffic signal ahead is broken.
The traffic signal ahead is showing green.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that a traffic signal is at the next intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a traffic signal is ahead. Slow down and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign is placed at the start of one-way streets and ramps. It means you cannot drive in your current direction.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They prepare drivers for upcoming road conditions and hazards. This sign warns of a bridge with narrow lanes ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This three-sided sign tells drivers to slow down at an intersection and be ready to stop. Yield to other drivers or pedestrians. You can go when it is safe.

questions.question: What should you do at a yield sign?

options.text: Always stop before entering the intersection.
Yield only to traffic on the right.
Yield only to traffic on the left.
Slow down and let other traffic go first.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and let other traffic go first.
questions.explanation: A yield sign means slow down and let other vehicles go first before you enter the intersection or road.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: A road joins from the right.
The road turns sharply right, then sharply left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road turns sharply right, then sharply left.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road ahead will turn sharply right and then sharply left.

questions.question: What should you do at a school crossing sign?

options.text: Always stop, even without a stop sign.
Watch for children and be ready to stop.
Always use your horn when you see children.
Be ready to help children cross the street.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for children and be ready to stop.
questions.explanation: Always watch for children at school crossings. Be ready to stop if a child is in or about to enter the crosswalk.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road becomes slippery when it is wet.

questions.question: A driver's left arm and hand are extended downward. What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: When a driver extends their left arm and hand downward, they are signaling that they plan to stop. Watch for this signal and adjust your driving if needed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Watch for traffic on your right.
Don't park on the right side of the street.

questions.explanation: A red circle with a red slash through a symbol means that action is not allowed. This sign means you cannot turn right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A red circle with a red slash means the action is prohibited. This sign means you cannot make a U-turn where it is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This warning sign tells you that a stop sign is coming. Prepare to stop completely before the intersection.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a steep downhill grade is coming.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign is posted at traffic lights where you are not allowed to turn right when the light is red.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a railroad crossing is coming. Watch for trains.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers in the left lane that they must turn left. You must obey this rule.

questions.question: What does this sign tell you?

options.text: There is a steep hill ahead.
No trucks are allowed on an upcoming hill.
There are trucks on an upcoming hill.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a steep hill ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a steep hill or downgrade is ahead.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Cars in right lane must slow down.
Pass only in the right lane.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that two lanes of traffic are about to become one lane. Be ready to merge.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This warning sign tells you a traffic light is coming. Be ready to stop or slow down.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Sharp right turn in the road ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Sharp right turn in the road ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a sharp right turn is ahead.

options.text: Entrances from the wrong direction on one-way streets and expressway ramps.

questions.correctAnswerText: Entrances from the wrong direction on one-way streets and expressway ramps.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road has one-way traffic. Do not enter from your current direction.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Lane ends or roadway narrows ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Lane ends or roadway narrows ahead.
questions.explanation: This warning sign tells you that the right lane is ending or the road is getting narrower ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This orange construction sign warns that construction ahead will change your normal route. Follow the detour signs.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Keep to the side indicated by the arrow.
You may drive in the left lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Keep to the side indicated by the arrow.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you to stay on the side shown by the arrow. An island, median, or barrier is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Eight-sided signs mean you must stop. Yield to other vehicles and pedestrians. Go when it is safe.

questions.question: What type of sign has this shape and color?
questions.explanation: Pennant-shaped signs mean no passing zone. Do not pass other vehicles in this area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that your vehicle will be towed if you park in this area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and prepare to stop if cars are coming.
Stop completely, then go when it is safe.
Go slowly through the intersection without always stopping.
Stop only if traffic is on the crossing road.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop completely, then go when it is safe.
questions.explanation: A stop sign means you must stop completely. Yield to vehicles and pedestrians. Go only when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Drive slowly and honk your horn.
You are entering a school parking lot.

questions.explanation: This yellow sign with black markings warns you a school zone is coming. Slow down and watch for children.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow diamond sign warns that the divided highway is ending. Be ready for oncoming traffic.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Watch for workers on or near the road.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for workers on or near the road.
questions.explanation: This sign warns of workers in or near the road. Drive slowly and carefully in work zones.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You are about to enter a one-way street the wrong way.
Do not drive in this lane.
Left-turning traffic on green must yield to oncoming traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Left-turning traffic on green must yield to oncoming traffic.
questions.explanation: This sign with a traffic light means left-turning traffic does not have the right-of-way. Wait for oncoming traffic to pass before turning.

questions.question: The driver's left arm and hand are extended upward. What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: Left arm extended upward means the driver will turn right. Adjust your driving if you are following this vehicle.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you not to stop your vehicle in the intersection. Keep the intersection clear for other traffic.
